## Some maps

The models here were built in ANAE wetlands.

```{r}
anaes <- readRDS(file.path(datOut, 'anae_simplify', 'all_anae_simplify.rds'))
```

```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = HydroBOT::basin, fill = 'black') +
  geom_sf(data = anaes, fill = 'lightskyblue2', color = NA,
          linewidth = 0.1, stroke = 0.1) +
  HydroBOT::theme_werp_toolkit()
```

The models for the werptstyle models (in other parts of SRA) were built largely on the EWR tool.

```{r}
ewrgauges <- HydroBOT::get_ewr_gauges()
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = HydroBOT::basin, fill = 'black') +
  geom_sf(data = HydroBOT::basin_rivers, color = 'dodgerblue') +
  geom_sf(data = ewrgauges, color = 'goldenrod') +
  HydroBOT::theme_werp_toolkit()
```
